translations.literal: At the time Western learning had reached China but was not yet flourishing; apparatus for experiment was exceedingly scarce.
translations.idiomatic: Western learning had only begun to reach China and was not yet well established; equipment for experiment was almost impossible to find.

sentences.zh: 壽與金匱華蘅芳討論搜求，始得十一，苦心研索，每以意求之，而得其真。

translations.literal: Shou and Hua Hengfang of Jingui discussed and searched together; at first they obtained only one item in ten, but through painstaking study, reasoning by intuition, they grasped the truth.
translations.idiomatic: Shou and Hua Hengfang of Jingui debated and hunted for answers together. At first they could verify scarcely one claim in ten, yet through relentless study—often reasoning their way forward by sheer intuition—they arrived at the truth.

sentences.zh: 嘗購三棱玻璃不可得，磨水晶印章成三角形，驗得光分七色。

translations.literal: Once unable to buy a triangular prism, he ground a crystal seal into a triangle and confirmed that light splits into seven colors.
translations.idiomatic: Unable once to obtain a triangular glass prism, he ground a crystal seal into a triangle and proved that light separates into seven colors.

sentences.zh: 知槍彈之行拋物線，疑其仰攻俯擊有異，設遠近多靶以測之，其成學之艱類此。

translations.literal: Knowing that bullets travel in parabolic arcs, he suspected that firing upward and downward differed, and set up targets at various distances to test it—such was the difficulty of his self-made education.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing that bullets follow a parabolic path, he suspected that firing upward and firing downward were not the same, and set up targets at many ranges to test the matter—such was the labor of teaching himself.

sentences.zh: 久之，於西學具窺見原委，尤精製器。

translations.literal: In time he gained a full view of Western learning and was especially skilled at making instruments.
translations.idiomatic: In time he came to see the full scope of Western learning and grew especially adept at building instruments.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十一年，從大學士曾國籓軍，先後於安慶、江寧設機器局，皆預其事。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 11 he joined Grand Secretary Zeng Guofan's army and took part in establishing arsenals successively at Anqing and Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng he entered the service of Grand Secretary Zeng Guofan and helped establish arsenals first at Anqing and then at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 壽與蘅芳及吳嘉廉、龔芸棠試造木質輪船，推求動理，測算汽機，蘅芳之力為多；

translations.literal: Shou, together with Hengfang, Wu Jialian, and Gong Yuntang, experimented with building a wooden steamship; they worked out the principles of motion and calculated the steam engine—Hengfang contributed the most effort;
translations.idiomatic: Shou, Hengfang, Wu Jialian, and Gong Yuntang attempted to build a wooden steamship, working out the laws of motion and calculating the steam engine—Hengfang bore the heaviest share of that labor;

sentences.zh: 造器罝機，皆出壽手製，不假西人，數年而成。

translations.literal: but the manufacture of parts and installation of machinery all came from Shou's own hands, without reliance on Westerners, and was completed after several years.
translations.idiomatic: yet the fabrication of parts and assembly of machinery were entirely Shou's own handiwork, accomplished without Western help over several years.

sentences.zh: 長五十餘尺，每一時能行四十餘裡，名之曰黃鵠。

translations.literal: Over fifty feet long, it could travel more than forty li in an hour and was named the Yellow Swan.
translations.idiomatic: More than fifty feet long, it could cover over forty li in an hour and was christened the Yellow Swan.

sentences.zh: 國籓激賞之，招入幕府，以奇才異能薦。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was deeply impressed, brought him into his staff, and recommended him for extraordinary talent.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was deeply impressed, took him onto his staff, and recommended him to the throne as a man of rare ability.

sentences.zh: 既而設製造局於上海，百事草創，壽於船砲槍彈，多所發明。

translations.literal: When the Jiangnan Arsenal was later established in Shanghai amid the work of building from scratch, Shou made many inventions in ships, cannon, and ammunition.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau was later set up in Shanghai, with everything to be invented from nothing, Shou devised many improvements in ships, cannon, and projectiles.

sentences.zh: 自製強水棉花藥、汞爆藥。

translations.literal: He devised his own nitric acid, guncotton, and mercury fulminate.
translations.idiomatic: He produced his own nitric acid, guncotton, and mercury fulminate.

sentences.zh: 創議繙譯西書，以求製造根本。

translations.literal: He proposed translating Western books to lay a foundation for manufacturing.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed translating Western books in order to establish a true foundation for manufacturing.

sentences.zh: 於是聘西士偉力亞利、傅蘭雅、林樂知、金楷理等，壽與同志華蘅芳、李鳳苞、王德均、趙元益孳孳研究，先後成書數百種。

translations.literal: Western scholars Alexander Wylie, John Fryer, Young J. Allen, and Cornelius Keng were engaged; Shou worked tirelessly with his colleagues Hua Hengfang, Li Fengbao, Wang Dejun, and Zhao Yuanyi, and together they eventually produced several hundred volumes.
translations.idiomatic: Western scholars Alexander Wylie, John Fryer, Young J. Allen, and Cornelius Keng were hired; Shou labored alongside Hua Hengfang, Li Fengbao, Wang Dejun, and Zhao Yuanyi, and together they eventually turned out several hundred volumes.

sentences.zh: 壽所譯述者，曰西藝知新及續編，化學鑑原及續編、補編，化學考質，化學求數，物體遇熱改易說，汽機發軔，營陣揭要，測地繪圖，寶藏興焉。

translations.literal: Shou's own translations and compilations included Illustrated New Western Arts and Further Illustrations, The Principles of Chemistry and its continuations, A Practical Course of Qualitative Analysis, Chemical Calculations, On the Alterations of Bodies by Heat, The First Steps in the Steam Engine, Essentials of Military Arrangements, Surveying and Mapping, and A Review of Precious Minerals.
translations.idiomatic: Among Shou's translations and compilations were Illustrated New Western Arts and its sequel, The Principles of Chemistry with its continuations and supplements, A Practical Course of Qualitative Analysis, Chemical Calculations, On the Alterations of Bodies by Heat, The First Steps in the Steam Engine, Essentials of Military Arrangements, Surveying and Mapping, and A Review of Precious Minerals.

sentences.zh: 法律、醫學，刊行者凡十三種，西藝知新、化學鑑原二書，尤稱善本。

translations.literal: Thirteen works on law and medicine were also published; Illustrated New Western Arts and The Principles of Chemistry in particular were regarded as exemplary editions.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen works on law and medicine were also issued in print; Illustrated New Western Arts and The Principles of Chemistry were especially esteemed as fine editions.

sentences.zh: 同治末，與傅蘭雅設格致書院於上海，風氣漸開，成就甚眾，壽名益播。

translations.literal: In the late Tongzhi reign he and John Fryer founded the Polytechnic Institute in Shanghai; interest gradually spread, many were trained, and Shou's fame grew.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Tongzhi reign he and John Fryer founded the Polytechnic Institute in Shanghai; the new learning slowly took hold, many students were trained, and Shou's reputation spread ever wider.

sentences.zh: 山東、四川仿設​​機器局，爭延聘壽主其事，以譯書事尤急，皆謝不往，而使其子建寅、華封代行。

translations.literal: Shandong and Sichuan set up arsenals on the same model and vied to hire Shou to head them; because translation work was more urgent still, he declined all such offers and sent his sons Jianyin and Huafeng in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong and Sichuan followed suit with arsenals of their own and competed to engage Shou as director, but translation remained the more pressing task; he declined every invitation and sent his sons Jianyin and Huafeng in his place.

sentences.zh: 大冶煤鐵礦、開平煤礦、漠河金礦經始之際，壽皆為擘畫規制。

translations.literal: When the Daye coal and iron mines, Kaiping coal mines, and Mohe gold mines were first opened, Shou drafted the plans and regulations for each.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the Daye coal and iron works, the Kaiping coal mines, and the Mohe gold fields, Shou drew up the plans and regulations for each.

sentences.zh: 購器選匠，資其力焉。

translations.literal: He also helped procure equipment and select craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: He also assisted in purchasing equipment and choosing skilled workers.

sentences.zh: 無錫產桑宜蠶，西商購繭奪民利，壽考求烘繭法，倡設烘灶，及機器繅絲法，育蠶者利驟增。

translations.literal: Wuxi produced mulberry suited to silkworms, but Western merchants bought cocoons at the people's expense; Shou studied cocoon-drying methods, promoted drying kilns, and introduced machine reeling, greatly increasing the profits of sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxi's mulberry was ideal for silkworms, yet Western merchants bought cocoons and cut into local profits; Shou investigated methods of drying cocoons, promoted drying kilns, and introduced machine reeling, sharply raising the earnings of sericulturists.

sentences.zh: 壽狷介，不求仕進，以布衣終。

translations.literal: Shou was upright and aloof; he sought no official advancement and died a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Shou was proud and uncompromising; he never sought office and died in plain clothes.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，卒，年六十七。

translations.literal: He died during the Guangxu reign at the age of sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the Guangxu reign at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 子建寅、華封，皆世其學。

translations.literal: His sons Jianyin and Huafeng both inherited his learning.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Jianyin and Huafeng both carried on his craft.

sentences.zh: 建寅，字仲虎。

translations.literal: Jianyin, styled Zhonghu.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyin, courtesy name Zhonghu.

sentences.zh: 從父於江寧、上海，助任製造。

translations.literal: He followed his father at Jiangning and Shanghai and assisted in manufacturing.
translations.idiomatic: He followed his father to Jiangning and Shanghai and helped with manufacturing work.

sentences.zh: 尋充山東機器局總辦，福建船政提調，出使德國二等參贊，洊擢直隸候補道。

translations.literal: Later he served as director of the Shandong Arsenal, superintendent of the Fujian Naval Yard, second-class attaché on a mission to Germany, and was repeatedly promoted to expectant intendant of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as director of the Shandong Arsenal, superintendent of the Fujian Naval Yard, and second secretary on a mission to Germany, and was repeatedly promoted to expectant intendant of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，張之洞調至湖北監造無菸火藥，已成，藥炸裂，殞焉，賜優恤。

translations.literal: In the late Guangxu reign Zhang Zhidong transferred him to Hubei to supervise the manufacture of smokeless powder; when it was finished the powder exploded and he was killed; he was granted special posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the late Guangxu reign Zhang Zhidong summoned him to Hubei to oversee production of smokeless powder; when the work was complete the charge detonated and killed him, and the court granted him special posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 華封，字祝三。

translations.literal: Huafeng, styled Zhusan.
translations.idiomatic: Huafeng, courtesy name Zhusan.

sentences.zh: 性敏，為父所愛，秘說精器多授之，以製造為治生。

translations.literal: Quick of mind and beloved by his father, he was entrusted with many secret formulas and refined instruments, and made his living through manufacturing.
translations.idiomatic: Quick-witted and favored by his father, he received many secret formulas and delicate instruments, and earned his living through manufacturing.

sentences.zh: 建寅、華封並從父譯書行於世。

translations.literal: Jianyin and Huafeng both followed their father in translating books that circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyin and Huafeng both followed their father in translating books that went out into the world.
